note.en: The two options of infernals.1015; the restrained option sets Hyperthermia_Lv4_denied and the crucible only gets the peaceful stage that does not unlock the next crisis level

notes.zh: 评注：隐藏事件 infernals.1041 在「动员」计时结束时宣战并启动「星系火风暴」状况；1040 的联盟选项设置 anti_hyperthermia_coalition 标记，决定谁参战。1050（危机国家被灭，终止状况）与 1054（己方熔炉被夺回）为隐藏事件，无可读文本。
notes.en: Commentary: hidden infernals.1041 declares the war and starts the Firestorm situation when the Mobilization timer ends; the coalition option of 1040 sets anti_hyperthermia_coalition, which decides who joins. 1050 (crisis country destroyed, situations aborted) and 1054 (own crucible recaptured) are hidden events with no readable text (events/infernals_crisis_events.txt:574-752, 821-840, 1065-1075).

uncertain: Hidden conduit/objective events infernals.2000-2020 (monthly Entropy Crystal rewards) are not story docs and are not shown
Exact doomclock timing depends on core systems held (situation monthly_progress), not fixed
